name: harness42: AI repo brief (claude -p, read-only tools)

parameters.command: cd "$HOME/Documents/harness42" && claude -p 'In five bullets: what changed on this branch and what is left to do? Cite files.' --allowedTools 'Read,Grep,Glob,Bash(git status:*),Bash(git log:*),Bash(git diff:*)' --output-format text
